evidenceClass: Synthetic historical human records, not current-world evidence or observed model output

questions.title: Deletion verification before pilot access
questions.question: What deletion dry-run result is needed before enabling pilot access?

humanReview.decision: Before enabling pilot access on October 30, obtain and review a deletion dry-run result. Do not broaden access until the result has been reviewed.

currentEvidence.title: Weekly signup observation
currentEvidence.body: The synthetic signup cohort contains twelve accounts this week.

semanticExpectations: A recorded past decision supplies a pending clarification, never proof the dry run happened or remains incomplete.
Empty current evidence permits a separate pending-question section and must not manufacture factual discussion topics or model calls.
An unrelated cohort observation must not be cited as support for deletion verification.
Original report, topic, week and decision identity remain stable across later reporting weeks.
A bounded prompt may omit questions visibly, while the complete input and persisted pending state remain intact.
Source-unavailable questions are withheld upstream; generation may communicate only the supplied unavailable count.
Same-title questions with distinct original IDs remain separate; carried questions are never merged by fuzzy topic matching.
